# Razorpay AI Buildathon — Submission Checklist

## Required for Submission (Google Form)

- [ ] **Public GitHub repo** with all code
- [ ] **5-minute pitch video** (YouTube unlisted, Loom, or Google Drive link)
- [ ] **Architecture document** — done (`docs/architecture.md`)
- [ ] **README with quickstart** — done
- [ ] **Application form** filled at https://forms.gle/d9r2gvxp8cmoZhon9

## Demo Artifacts (Auto-Generated by `run_demo.py`)

- [x] `audit_log.jsonl` — every decision + outcome
- [x] `metrics_report.json` — recovery rate, escalation count
- [x] `eval_report.json` — accuracy on 18 cases
- [x] `voice_notes/*.mp3` — Hinglish voice notes for high-value

## Code Completeness

- [x] Hard-coded compliance rules (RBI + network caps)
- [x] PII redaction before all LLM calls
- [x] Idempotency keys on all write actions
- [x] Budget governor (3 interventions/customer/month)
- [x] Graceful Gemini fallback (escalation on failure)
- [x] DLT template selection (no freeform text)
- [x] Hinglish voice note generation
- [x] 18-case hand-labeled eval set
- [x] Honest simulation disclosure
- [x] Unit tests for compliance + triage

## What This Project Does NOT Claim

- ❌ Real Razorpay API calls (we used the mock server)
- ❌ Production recovery rates (simulated, not measured)
- ❌ Real bank behavior modeling (synthetic test data)
- ❌ A/B test against Razorpay's default retry (would require real merchants)

See `docs/methodology.md` for the full honest disclosure.

## Pre-Submission Steps (Do These Last)

1. [ ] Run `python backend/scripts/run_demo.py` — verify no errors
2. [ ] Run `pytest backend/tests/ -v` — verify all tests pass
3. [ ] Commit everything: `git add . && git commit -m "Chakra v1.0"`
4. [ ] Push to GitHub: `git push origin main`
5. [ ] Record 5-min video following `docs/PITCH_SCRIPT.md`
6. [ ] Upload video, get share link
7. [ ] Fill Google Form: name, email, college, grad year, Bangalore availability, GitHub link, video link
8. [ ] Submit before **Sept 5 noon IST**
